modules.label: Equipment Tracking
modules.summary: Register / edit equipment, view details and QR labels, search and export inventory.

modules.label: Projects
modules.summary: View projects and project detail; Admin project management and assignments.

modules.label: Requests
modules.summary: Review requests; approve, reject and release eligible requests.

modules.label: Transfers
modules.summary: Monitor handovers and their records; Admin cannot act as the named field receiver.

modules.label: Returns
modules.summary: Monitor recorded returns; no separate Admin acceptance stage.

modules.label: Repairs
modules.summary: Review repair cases; start and complete eligible repairs.

modules.label: Missing
modules.summary: Review missing cases and record eligible Good / Damaged recovery.

modules.label: Material Requests
modules.summary: Manage consumable items / stock and material requests; record receipts or cancel outstanding requests.

modules.label: Purchases
modules.summary: View and save purchase ledger records with optional private receipts; does not receive stock.

modules.label: Reports
modules.summary: Load monitoring reports for a selected period and export PDF.

modules.label: Activity Logs
modules.summary: Search saved movement activity, follow record links and export PDF.

modules.label: People & Accountability
modules.summary: Manage company people, accounts and accountability using Admin controls.

modules.label: Settings
modules.summary: View My account identity, change display theme and log out; roles are managed by Admin.
